correctness.rationale: For every fixed d, the exact reverse isolation interval gives the maximum-neighbor rank for death. Independent uniform priorities yield a finite-range marked array; singleton configurations give the product intensity \(2d x^{2d-1}\,dx\,ds\,du\) uniform direction, and overlap clusters have extra small-priority factors \(O(n^{-1/(2d)})\), so all mixed factorial moments converge. Non-isolated invalid centers vanish, and uniform empirical ranks transfer the result. Time-change yields gamma-ordered deaths with independent marks. Six exhaustive small cases yielded 944805 exact assertions; finite cases are checks, not proof of the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: This is the full joint extreme-event classification for the naturally motivated dynamic question of where, when, and by which neighbor the last isolated vertices cease to be isolated, including successive order statistics and asymptotic independence of birth fractions, sites and killing directions. It meaningfully refines the previously one-dimensional Weibull boundary and is not merely an arbitrary finite count or parameter substitution.
